scope: Generic source checks for recorded gastric diagnostic history; no patient data and no independent clinical approval.

sources.matchedContent: Stomach discomfort, nausea and anemia can occur with gastric cancer. These findings are nonspecific; they do not establish this patient’s symptom or anemia mechanism.

sources.publisher: 国立がん研究センター がん情報サービス
sources.matchedContent: Endoscopy identifies lesions; histopathology establishes cancer. Do not add an unrecorded biopsy or equate finding a tumor with histologic confirmation.

sources.title: Stomach Cancer Symptoms
sources.matchedContent: Indigestion, stomach discomfort and nausea are possible symptoms, also caused by other conditions.

sources.title: Stomach Cancer Diagnosis
sources.matchedContent: Anemia evaluation and upper endoscopy with biopsy are part of diagnostic assessment; individual test results must come from the record.

implementation.rule: Connect symptoms → screening anemia → examination finding only when explicitly ordered within the same dated medical-history passage. Use related_to with a visible 経過 label; examination → recorded diagnosis uses supports.
implementation.limitations: Neither temporal order nor a nonspecific symptom proves causation. Do not infer tumor bleeding, pathology, a specific mechanism, or that discomfort prompted screening. Distinct findings and all source evidence remain preserved.
